bio: Thomas Patrick Tiffany (born December 30, 1957) is an American politician and businessman from Wisconsin. A member of the United States House of Representatives, he has represented Wisconsin's 7th congressional district since 2020. A member of the Republican Party, he is a member of the House Freedom Caucus.
offices: Member of the Wisconsin State Assembly (2011–2013)
Member of the State Senate of Wisconsin (2013–2020)
